pathlight.label: Open the study space
pathlight.note: Continue to the Bible study and reflection app.

lakbay.label: Reserve founding access
lakbay.note: Choose a founding membership and continue through Lakbay’s reservation flow.

edit.label: Read the journal
edit.note: Explore stories and reading tools in ÉDIT.

the-wedding-architect.label: Start a wedding brief
the-wedding-architect.note: Build your wedding brief in The Wedding Architect. The builder saves a draft; it does not confirm a booking.

lexi-solis.label: Contact the studio
lexi-solis.note: Contact Lexi Solis about creative work, collaborations, or commissions.

dctor.label: Find a doctor
dctor.note: Find a doctor and continue through Dctor’s own appointment flow.

aurelia.label: Browse the collection
aurelia.note: Browse available jewelry in Aurelia. For a purchase inquiry, you can also send a request through Solis.

novel-reader.label: Open the reader
novel-reader.note: Continue to the manuscript reading and writing workspace.

house-of-solis.label: Inquire with the atelier
house-of-solis.note: Send fitting, dress, or bespoke requests through the House of Solis inquiry page.

pulse.label: Join early access
pulse.note: Continue to Pulse’s own early-access page.

keepsake.label: Open the journal studio
keepsake.note: Choose a journal or album template and create it in Keepsake. Memories stay on your device.

the-cake-architect.label: Create a cake brief
the-cake-architect.note: Choose a cake and use Create your cake in Butter & Bloom. The builder saves a brief; it does not place an order.

tara.label: Book a demo ride
tara.note: Choose a car, tricycle, or motorcycle in Tara. Rides, fares, and driver matching are simulated.

forma.label: Start a project brief
forma.note: The planner creates a downloadable brief; it does not submit an inquiry.

solana.label: Browse swimwear
solana.note: Explore a concept collection and checkout preview. Payments and fulfillment are not connected.

maven.label: Find an expert trainer
maven.note: Explore trainer profiles and booking workflow previews in Maven. Online training room creation requires sign-in.

imagine-games.label: Explore the games
imagine-games.note: Explore studio concepts, a linked game, and the browser arcade.

trendcut.label: Open the ad studio
trendcut.note: Discover dated product trends and use the motion-ad editor. AI tools depend on the app’s activation.

este-high-jewelry.label: Explore the collection
este-high-jewelry.note: Browse illustrative creations and prepare a local private-viewing inquiry; no appointment is reserved.

kapeng-barako.label: Explore the coffee menu
kapeng-barako.note: Browse concept drinks, pairings, and brewing tools. This page does not place an order.

helios.label: Prepare a solar brief
helios.note: Use the concept calculator and consultation brief; results require a professional site assessment.

drafting-company.label: Start a drafting brief
drafting-company.note: Explore drafting services and create a downloadable local brief; no inquiry is sent.

verse.label: Open the poetry studio
verse.note: Record thoughts and edit poetry. AI writing requires activation; no unavailable generation is simulated.
